headline: Card Loans, Which Hit a Record High Amid 'Debt-Fueled Investing,' Decline for Second Month
summary: Card loan balances at domestic card companies hit a record in May, then declined for two straight months. Nine card firms reported a combined balance of 42.8 trillion won at the end of July.
why: Card loans reflect household consumer credit, which affects consumer spending and the credit quality of Korean card issuers.
